articles.author: Erin Doherty, Jessie Blaeser
articles.title: ‘Ship has sailed’: New poll shows even an end to the war or lower gas prices may not save Republicans - Politico
articles.description: A new POLITICO Poll shows most Americans, especially Democratic and undecided voters, would not be moved even if Trump ended the Iran war or brought down gas prices.
articles.content:
Republicans are running out of ways to reverse their gloomy midterm prospects.
